title: Art. 3.8 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, C. Security of travel documents, 3.8
content: Contracting States shall establish controls to safeguard against the theft of their blank travel documents and the misappropriation of newly issued travel documents.
